description_en: Updates the cache of a page protected by a specified web tamper-proofing rule
description_zh: 更新指定网站防篡改规则所防护的页面的缓存
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-protection-rule-cache-status --domain www.example.com --rule-id 42755 --defense-type tamperproof --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2019-09-10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyProtectionRuleCacheStatus

parameters.help_en: The domain name that has been added
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html operation to query the IDs of all rules
parameters.help_zh:
配置规则ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/100398.html接口可以查询到所有规则ID
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The protection module. Set the value to tamperproof
parameters.help_zh: 防护功能模块。固定取值：tamperproof
parameters.name: defense_type

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.
Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/140857.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id
